If you’re starting a business and only using Alibaba, you need to know about 1688! 🇨🇳 Alibaba is built for international buyers, while 1688 is primarily for China’s domestic wholesale market. That means you can often find lower prices, more suppliers and products you might not see on Alibaba. But here’s the catch: 1688 isn’t necessarily cheaper once you factor in shipping, payment arrangements, sourcing agents and quality control. My advice? Compare BOTH before placing your order. Click the vendor link below to visit their Alibaba store. 2. Select “Chat Now” to contact the supplier directly. 3. Let them know you’re interested in custom-printed cookie bags for your bakery. 4. Send them your logo, brand colors, preferred bag dimensions, and any design inspiration you have. 5. Ask about their minimum order quantity (MOQ), pricing, production time, and shipping costs. 6. Always request a sample before placing a large order! This allows you to check the material, printing quality, and overall appearance. ✨ MY ADVICE: Don’t be afraid to ask questions! Make sure you know exactly what you’re purchasing, including whether the bags are food-safe and suitable for your cookies. Remember, presentation matters!
